note: Composite over stand at overlay_rect. Frame 0 is the closed mouth and is identical to stand there, so a talk loop that ends on 0 restores stand exactly. Body pixels never change.
downsampled: Frames written at 2.0x the largest drawn height (263px, the near zone). Source figures were 1616px, which is 6x linear and 38x the pixels anything can ever show. The full-size frames were downloaded at boot and resampled away on first use.
